tools.name: search_fonts
tools.title: Search Fonts Tool
tools.description: Search the free font catalog by name, category, style tags, language coverage, variable/monospace flags and style count. Returns a paginated list of families.

langs.description: Comma-separated language codes, e.g. 'latin,cyrillic' — ALL must be supported.

style.description: Comma-separated style tags, e.g. 'handwriting,condensed' — ALL must match. One of: handwriting, script, display, slab, rounded, condensed, expanded, stencil, pixel, blackletter, outline, retro.

tools.name: recognize_font
tools.title: Recognize Font Tool
tools.description: Identify which font is used in an image. Powered by our OWN CNN embedding model, trained on the jinero font catalog — it matches fonts by visual shape/style, so it needs NO OCR and NO text (works for Latin and Cyrillic). Send a tight crop of one line of text as either image_url (public URL) or image_base64 (base64/data-URI, e.g. a local screenshot). The image is processed in memory and deleted immediately — never stored. Returns the most visually similar font families with scores. Fast (~200 ms). Rate limit: 5 calls/min per IP (model inference is compute-heavy).

image_url.description: Public URL of an image — a tight crop of one line of text. Provide either this or image_base64. Recognition is by visual shape (no OCR/text needed); Latin & Cyrillic supported.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image (raw base64 or a data:image/...;base64 URI), max 8 MB decoded — use this to send a local file/screenshot without hosting it. Provide either this or image_url.

top_k.description: Number of font matches to return (3–20, default 8).

tools.name: get_font
tools.title: Get Font Tool
tools.description: Get full metadata for one font family by slug: styles, weights, axes, license, subsets and download/CSS URLs.

tools.name: get_font_files
tools.title: Get Font Files Tool
tools.description: List every font file (weight/italic/format + direct woff2/ttf URL) for a family — handy for building custom @font-face rules.

tools.name: get_fonts_css
tools.title: Get Fonts Css Tool
tools.description: Generate ready-to-use @font-face CSS for a family spec (Google-Fonts-compatible), e.g. "inter:wght@400,700" or a variable range "inter:wght@300..900". Returns CSS text.

tools.name: get_font_download_url
tools.title: Get Font Download Url Tool
tools.description: Return the direct ZIP download URL for a font family (all styles + a ready fonts.css). Does NOT download — hand the URL to the user or fetch it separately.

tools.name: check_contrast
tools.title: Check Contrast Tool
tools.description: Check the WCAG contrast ratio between a foreground and background color, with AA/AAA pass/fail for normal and large text.

tools.name: get_color_shades
tools.title: Get Color Shades Tool
tools.description: Generate tints and shades for a base color (lighter/darker steps) with hex values.

hex.description: Base color in hex, rgb(), or hsl().

tools.name: name_color
tools.title: Name Color Tool
tools.description: Get the closest human-readable name for one or more colors. Pass a single hex or several comma-separated (e.g. "#3b82f6,#000,#ff7f50"); returns each input with its nearest color name, the reference hex, an exact-match flag and the perceptual distance.

hex.description: A hex color, or several comma-separated (e.g. "#3b82f6,#000,#ff7f50"). Up to 100 at once.

tools.name: extract_colors
tools.title: Extract Colors Tool
tools.description: Extract a dominant-color palette from an image. Send either a public image_url or image_base64 (base64/data-URI, e.g. a local screenshot). The image is processed in memory and never stored. Each color comes back with its hex, rgb, hsl, share of the image, and the closest human color name — a named palette in one call. Rate limit: 10 calls/min per IP.

image_url.description: Public URL of the image to pull the palette from. Provide either this or image_base64.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image (raw base64 or a data:image/...;base64 URI), max 10 MB decoded — use this to send a local file/screenshot without hosting it. Provide either this or image_url.

count.description: How many colors to return (2–16, default 8).

tools.name: search_palettes
tools.title: Search Palettes Tool
tools.description: Search the color-palette catalog by name, tone, temperature, mood, harmony, exact color count and tags. Returns a paginated list.

mood.description: e.g. pastel, muted, earthy, vibrant, monochrome.

harmony.description: e.g. analogous, complementary, triadic, monochromatic, split-complementary, tetradic.

tools.name: get_palette
tools.title: Get Palette Tool
tools.description: Get one color palette by id: its colors (hex), name/derived title, mood, harmony, temperature and tags.

tools.name: minify_code
tools.title: Minify Code Tool
tools.description: Minify or beautify JS, CSS, HTML, SVG, JSON or XML text. Set type=auto to sniff the language. The code is only parsed and re-printed — never executed and never stored. Rate limit: 30 calls/min per IP.

tools.name: detect_code
tools.title: Detect Code Tool
tools.description: Detect the language/format of a code snippet. Static analysis only — the snippet is never executed and never stored.

tools.name: convert_code
tools.title: Convert Code Tool
tools.description: Convert code between text formats (e.g. JSON↔YAML, CSS↔SCSS). Pure text transformation: the source is parsed and re-serialized, never executed and never stored. Use list_code_converters for valid from/to ids and per-converter options. Rate limit: 30 calls/min per IP.

tools.name: list_code_converters
tools.title: List Code Converters Tool
tools.description: List available code converters with their from/to ids and per-converter option schemas.

tools.name: optimize_svg
tools.title: Optimize Svg Tool
tools.description: Optimize/clean SVG markup (SVGO). Pure markup transformation — nothing is executed or stored. Returns minified SVG plus before/after sizes. Rate limit: 30 calls/min per IP.

tools.name: svg_to_datauri
tools.title: Svg To Data Uri Tool
tools.description: Encode an SVG (or fetched image) as a CSS-ready data: URI. Provide either raw svg or a url. Rate limit: 30 calls/min per IP.

svg.description: Raw SVG markup. Mutually exclusive with url.

url.description: Public image URL the server will fetch.

encoding.description: Defaults: utf8 for SVG, base64 for raster.

quotes.description: Quote style for the data URI (default double).

tools.name: list_svg_presets
tools.title: List Svg Presets Tool
tools.description: List the available SVG optimization presets and what each one does.

tools.name: list_scss_mixins
tools.title: List Scss Mixins Tool
tools.description: List the SCSS mixin catalog (id, title, short description), optionally filtered by group or search.

tools.name: get_scss_mixin
tools.title: Get Scss Mixin Tool
tools.description: Get one SCSS mixin by id: full source, parameters and usage example.

tools.name: generate_clamp
tools.title: Generate Clamp Tool
tools.description: Calculate a fluid CSS clamp() expression for responsive sizing between two viewport widths. Pure calculation — returns a CSS snippet, writes and stores nothing.

root.description: Root font-size in px for rem conversion (default 16).
